skills.name: tdd-red-green-refactor
skills.title: TDD Red-Green-Refactor
skills.summary: Builds one behaviour at a time with separate red, green and optional refactor commits, so the git history proves every test came before the code. Works with any language or test runner, and includes an honest recipe for testing race conditions.
skills.imageAlt: Three round characters: a grumpy red one holding FAIL, a happy green one holding PASS, and a smug blue one in sunglasses with a broom.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.title: Grill Me
skills.summary: A relentless, one-question-at-a-time interview about your plan. For every question the agent offers its recommended answer, and it explores the codebase instead of asking when it can. You leave with every branch of the design decided.
skills.imageAlt: A robot with a clipboard asks question 17 of 40 while a sweating developer realises they had not thought about it.

skills.name: db-planning
skills.title: DB Planning
skills.summary: Database design in two stages: an interview that walks purpose, entities, access patterns, scale, constraints and operations, then versioned DBML and markdown plans under planning/db/ that you can render as diagrams and iterate on.
skills.imageAlt: A robot interviewer turns answers into DBML tables and versioned plan files.

skills.name: modular-development
skills.title: Modular Development
skills.summary: Locks the agent to the files you declare, then moves through build, tests, a review gate you control, a scoped merge and a global test check. Stops the 'while I was in there' refactors that leak across a codebase.
skills.imageAlt: A robot works inside a fenced sandbox labelled files in scope while the developer holds the key to the review gate.

skills.name: caveman
skills.title: Caveman
skills.summary: Ultra-compressed replies that keep every technical detail and drop the filler, cutting output tokens by roughly three quarters. Has intensity levels from lite to ultra, and switches back to full sentences for warnings and destructive actions.
skills.imageAlt: A verbose robot with a huge speech bubble next to a caveman robot that says only: Bug in auth. Fix.
